checklist: CI's cut of scroll-fast-2560: the same folder and size, Cull at tile 216 only, one fast wheel pass (frame pacing, blank tiles, thumbnail upscale, rows out of place, memory; reported, not gated). The full sweep (tile 144, dy 60, snaps) is scroll-fast-2560, in probe.sh scroll.

steps.name: thumb
steps.js: const r=__probe.logic().real.filter(p=>p.src).slice(0,40); return Promise.all(r.map(p=>fetch(p.src).then(x=>x.blob()).then(b=>new Promise(res=>{ const im=new Image(); im.onload=()=>res({kb:Math.round(b.size/1024),w:im.naturalWidth,h:im.naturalHeight}); im.onerror=()=>res(null); im.src=p.src; })))).then(a=>JSON.stringify(a.filter(Boolean)))
